Name: Moresheth-gath
Description: The home town of Micah the Morasthite, whose prophecy Jeremiah's elders quoted a century later to save Jeremiah's life, and the place Micah told to give parting gifts in his lament over Judah's towns.
BiblicalSignificance: Moresheth-gath gave Israel a prophet from the countryside, whose words outlived him long enough to rescue another prophet.
